reason: Independently reproduced 3/3 on Go 1.26.6 with a woven two-request app: A's io.ReadAll body slice, recycled while A is active, is refilled by B via append+strconv.AppendInt to the same length; string(buf) matches A's (ptr,len,KindBytes) root key, Lookup accepts the active foreign owner without a content check, and B's span reports SQL_INJECTION sourced from A's http.request.body. Different-length and A-finished controls are clean. README:43-46 documents stale ranges from unobserved append/copy writes but not cross-request attribution, which violates product rule 4. The trigger is narrow (the pool must recycle the io.ReadAll result, with an exact length match while A is live), so this sits at the low end of High. Go 1.27.0 is untestable because the woven testapp fails to build on the known encoding/json break.
